body:
This PR updates ClimaAtmos to work with the future breaking release of ClimaDiagnostics (https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaDiagnostics.jl/pull/206). The main change are that the time dimension are saved as dates instead of floating point which mean the `date` dimension does not exist anymore and the saved times of all writers are now at the beginning of the reduction period.

This PR also fixes diagnostics when restarting a land simulation.

I asked a LLM to make these changes.
